pages.text: [#](53341a)A large Otherwhere working that draws animal life into the circle from the countryside.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Beastial Call

pages.text: [#](53341a)Less a summoning than a lure — it coaxes creatures to answer a call they do not understand, wild or pastured alike.[#]()
[#](53341a)Offer barn and field bait: a milk bucket, hay bale, apple, beef, cod, red mushroom, carrot, and seeds, plus **6000 altar power**.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)It favors pigs, chickens, cows, sheep, mooshrooms, wolves, and ocelots.[#]()
[#](53341a)A coven of three or more suits the old craft. Do not cast it near a village ranch unless you can explain yourself.[#]()
